name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for tinkering with engines. He started as an apprentice mechanic, quickly displaying an aptitude for problem-solving and a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics. His career progressed through various engineering roles, culminating in his current position as Chief Engineer for the Sprint V8 Team. Ahmad believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing telemetry and performance metrics to optimize car setup and identify areas for improvement.

His distinctive approach is rooted in blending established engineering principles with innovative solutions. He fosters a collaborative environment within his team, encouraging open communication and the sharing of ideas. While he values teamwork, Ahmad's 'lone wolf' trait often sees him diving deep into complex problems independently, emerging with innovative solutions. His perfectionist tendencies ensure that every detail is scrutinized, contributing to the team's pursuit of excellence.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ahmad is a man of medium build with a focused gaze and a calm demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Insists on having a perfectly aligned set of tools on his workbench.
Repeatedly clicks his pen when deep in thought.
